verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's public documentation is static copy-paste code tabs with no in-page runner. The only runnable paths are its first-party Postman collection, which has a Run-in-Postman fork button, and a visual Request Builder that exists only inside the authenticated dashboard. So runnable exploration is possible, but only outside the reference itself. Missing for 10: an interactive in-docs API explorer with runnable examples, any OpenAPI spec to drive one, unauthenticated access to the Request Builder, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can also discover this API using our Postman collection covering every ScrapingBee's features
In the dashboard, go to Request builders > HTML and configure the request visually
The documentation itself is static copy-paste code tabs with no runner.
